relevance_note: Single-patient case report of Blau syndrome with a NOD2 variant: "DNA sequencing for all twelve coding regions of NOD2 was done and it showed heterozygous mutation in Glu498Gly".
method_note: Read the whole paper manually and built the JSON with a small Python script (values typed by hand, spans checked verbatim by script). One in-scope person (label 'patient', single unnamed case-report patient). Family members are mentioned only as untested and asymptomatic as a group, without individual detail, so they get no rows; prior families/cases in the Discussion (refs [3], [15]) have no individual-level facts and get no rows. Age at diagnosis 'two years old' is the age at the initial (later revised) diagnosis of polyarticular JIA, not of Blau syndrome; age at Blau syndrome diagnosis is not stated, and age at onset is not stated separately, so onset is 'not reported' (the arthritis feature row carries 'two years old' as onset of the JIA presentation). Age at last evaluation is the 23 years at referral; later follow-up ages are not given. Vital status left 'not reported' (not stated explicitly, though he is described in ongoing follow-up). Protein change printed as 'Glu498Gly' without 'p.' prefix; recorded as both original string and protein field; no cDNA or transcript printed. Variant type not stated by the authors for this variant. Several exclusions (no active synovitis, denied joint pain, normal inflammatory markers) refer to the present clinic visit only; the arthritis checklist item is observed from the history. Fever excluded from the gastroenterology visit denial. Checklist 'camptodactyly' left 'not reported': the paper reports 'flexion contracture of fingers of both hands' but never calls it camptodactyly. 'Interstitial lung disease' left 'not reported': lung involvement is described as granulomatous inflammation, micronodules and bronchiolitis obliterans (small airway disease), not as interstitial disease. 'Hepatomegaly or hepatic granulomas' observed from 'granulomatous hepatitis' on liver biopsy. Visual impairment observed from 'blurry vision'. Minor oddity: the text has 'Alkaline Phosphate: 716:  (45–115)' with an extra colon; recorded the value 716. No contradictions found.

span: His initial treatment consisted of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory (NSAIDs), later on methotrexate was added. He remained on methotrexate for about ten years
Subsequently, he was started on azathioprine, remained on it for three years, but was discontinued due to liver function abnormalities. After this, he was started on hydroxychloroquine.
it was recommended to continue hydroxychloroquine and prednisone

patient was diagnosed with systemic granulomatous inflammation: Blau syndrome and he was started on Adalimumab. With the initiation of Adalimumab, there was marked improvement in Ophthalmologic symptoms.
